name: Stereogram
one_liner: Free stereogram (Magic Eye) generator in the browser: shapes, text, a drawing or your own depth map; random dots or a pattern; print-size PNG; no account.

kill_criteria.statement: Not live at stereogram.dravec.org with shapes, text, upload, PNG export and the viewing guide by the deadline

moves.name: The patient eye: a six-step viewing ladder with self-set "seen it" marks
From the paper: the 1994 formula and row links shown live
Message card: a hidden-word greeting with a note, A6 print preset

remains.what: A deterministic, offline, print-resolution renderer with reproducible seeds and shareable links, usable with no model at all; "method" follows once the viewing ladder (signature A) is approved and live.

next_gate.statement: building → soft-launch: live at stereogram.dravec.org, CI green, one approved signature move live and measured, analytics verified in flywheel-core, ≥1 feedback row; decide by 2026-11-18.

notes: Scaffolded 2026-11-04 per /flywheel:scaffold. Algorithm: Thimbleby–Inglis–Witten 1994 with hidden-surface removal, pure TS in src/domain, rendered in a Web Worker. Signature proposal (3 options, recommendation A "The patient eye") awaits Pavol; the core generator is the obvious part and shipped. One-liner and track were set by the agent as defaults; Pavol to confirm.
